Mina: AcmeEdge asked for exact security artifacts for the listing + joint announcement. They want an example of a supply-chain attestation for firmware. What do we accept?

Omar: We require a signed firmware attestation (PDF with signature or PGP-signed JSON) that states build pipeline, signer identity, and image hashes. Include the build ID and sha256 of the firmware.

Jules: Add a short BOM (bill of materials) for hardware: main components, vendor, and fw version. Put BOM file type as artifact_type=bom in the manifest.

Priya: Redaction rules: partners can redact customer-specific or vendor-internal IP, but must include a redaction_notice and provide a sample redacted page + its sha256 in the manifest. We accept vendor attestations for why redactions were made.

Mina: Good. Upload flow? Presigned S3 with TTL?

Omar: Presign recommended. Use prefix: s3://redwood-marketplace/acmeedge/{release}/. TTL 5 days by default. Example we give partners:

```
aws s3 cp acmeedge-assurance.zip s3://redwood-marketplace/acmeedge/v2024-11/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/acmeedge/v2024-11/acmeedge-assurance.zip --expires-in 432000
```

Jules: File size note: prefer <1.5GB per archive. If firmware images push size, split into parts and include root_manifest.txt listing parts + checksums.

Priya: Intake checklist for signoff: manifest.csv/jsonl with filename, sha256, artifact_type, redacted (yes/no), redaction_notes, contact. SOC attestation (cover letter ok), pen test executive summary + remediation CSV, third-party scan summary, firmware attestation if HW, BOM if HW, sample redaction page. No critical open findings.

Mina: Marketing needs a go/no-go by Nov 12 to hit announcement on Nov 15. Can security triage in 72 hours?

Priya: If manifest + summaries arrive, yes 72-hour triage. Full pen report reviews take longer.

sec-bot: Reminder: upload guidance page: https://intranet.redwood/marketplace-intake. Required: manifest, soc attestation, pen summary, remediation tracker, firmware attestation (if hardware). :robot_face:

Mina: I'll share the manifest template and presign instructions with AcmeEdge today and ask for links by Nov 9. Will update thread when uploaded. Thanks!
